patch_resolves_note: The staged fix applies cleanly, the instrumented fixed original stays clean, and it still reaches the same `CoverageFormat2::Iter::more()` / `BEInt<unsigned short, 2>::operator unsigned short()` path with the caller-owned coverage object preserved instead of copied onto the constructor stack.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: When `SingleSubstFormat2::closure()` initializes `hb_auto_t<Coverage::Iter>` from `this+coverage`, the `Coverage` object received by `Coverage::Iter::init(c_)` must still alias that caller-owned table object rather than a shorter-lived copy.
root_cause_criterion.description: The crashing path reaches `Coverage::Iter::init(c_)` with a different object identity than the caller-selected `this+coverage`, which is the observable effect of the step-2 by-value `hb_auto_t` constructor. That identity change is what lets later format-2 iteration retain a pointer into constructor-local stack storage.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original violates the identity predicate while still executing `format2_iter_more`. The fixed original reaches the same protected event with equality preserved, so the root obligation is verified by a genuine fixed-side witness.

nodes.state: `CoverageFormat2::Iter::init()` stores `c = &c_`, so the iterator aliases the exact format-2 coverage subtable selected upstream.
nodes.evidence: Both vulnerable and fixed assertion traces satisfy `coverage_iter_root.format2_subtable_addr == format2_iter_init.iter_c_addr` on the selected format-2 path.

nodes.state: `CoverageFormat2::Iter::more()` reuses the same iterator member `c` that `CoverageFormat2::Iter::init()` stored before evaluating `c->rangeRecord.len`.
nodes.evidence: Both vulnerable and fixed assertion traces satisfy `format2_iter_init.iter_c_addr == format2_iter_more.iter_c_addr`.

nodes.state: The big-endian conversion sink reads the exact two-byte `rangeRecord.len` field selected in `CoverageFormat2::Iter::more()`.
nodes.evidence: Both vulnerable and fixed assertion traces satisfy `format2_iter_more.range_record_len_addr == beint_len_read.beint_this_ptr` at the sink.
